messages:
maya: Heads-up: planning a geo-staggered canary for model_v14 starting Mon 09:00 PST. Toggle is `flags/model_v14_canary`. Initial slice: NA 1% / EU 1%. Ramp to 5/5 after 30m, then 20/10 after 2h if signals okay. Need infra + oncall + CS signoff. :calendar:

sam: Quick Q — is the toggle controlled via Terraform or the feature-service? I have a change ready but can hold.

kevin: Oncall here. Please add rollback criteria. Suggest: p95 latency +25% OR error rate > 0.5% absolute OR token cost spike > 30%. Also need a circuit-breaker route to drop to v13 if we hit thresholds.

maya: Sam — feature-service runtime toggle, but we still need a tf state update for the IAM binding (svc-account). i'll drop the PR.

sara: CS: tagging here. Any user-visible behavioral changes? We only changed decoding config (better quality), no schema changes. Will notify key enterprise customers in NA/EU.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: Preflight check passed: infra health ok, capacity reserved 4 GPUs across regions.

lee: Ops check — can we schedule the NA ramp first and delay EU by 15m to watch regional telemetry?

maya: yes — plan: NA ramp first (1% -> 5% -> 20%), EU delayed 15m (1% -> 5% -> 10%). Will annotate rollout doc.

sam: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/feature-service/+/r1234 — includes toggle name, rollout schedule, and tf IAM diff. Please review.

kevin: Runbook snippet for quick rollback: 
``
# rollback
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.internal/flags/model_v14_canary/off
# fallback route will reassign to model_v13
``

maya: add heartbeat checks to alerting: p95 latency > 500ms or error rate > 0.5% -> PagerDuty. Can we add a synthetic user flow in NA/EU?

devops-bot: synthetic-job scheduled: canary-synthetic-northamerica and canary-synthetic-eu every 1m.

sara: noted. I'll prepare a customer note and send to the support rotation.

sam: I've added a small dashboard: /dashboards/model_v14_canary — includes p95, token cost, error rate, median latency. Share with oncall.

kevin: Oncall ack. I'll be available Mon 08:30 PST for final go/no-go. :thumbsup: 

maya: Thanks — checklist: PR merged, tf applied, synth jobs running, alerts set, CS notified, oncall ack. I'll post final start message Mon 08:50 PST.

lee: One last ask: add a quick metric to detect traffic skew (region percent != planned by > 3pp). If we accidentally send more EU traffic we need auto-hold.

maya: good call — enabling hold-policy `canary_auto_hold_on_skew`. I'll add to toggle config.

oncall-bot: pagerduty: rotation alert rule added for model_v14_oncall.

kevin: All good from me. :eyes: 

maya: Great — thanks everyone. I'll post the timeline and link to the runbook in the thread before deploy.
